Name: NETWORK_PARAM_ST
Description: Online battle settings: 1v1 (solo match) and 3v3 (team match) text and cutscene IDs, round and time limits, scoring, respawn and resupply rules, matchmaking intervals, remote character smoothing and battle BGM.

Fields.Name: 1v1: Pre-Round Text ID
Fields.Description: Text presentation ID shown before a 1v1 round starts.

Fields.Name: Pre-Round Text Minimum Wait Time
Fields.Description: Minimum time the pre-round text is shown before a 1v1 or 3v3 round starts. In seconds.

Fields.Name: 1v1: Round Start Text ID
Fields.Description: Text presentation ID shown right after a 1v1 round starts.

Fields.Name: 1v1: Opponent Destroyed Text ID
Fields.Description: Text presentation ID shown when the opponent is destroyed in 1v1.

Fields.Name: 1v1: Player Destroyed Text ID
Fields.Description: Text presentation ID shown when the player is destroyed in 1v1.

Fields.Name: 1v1: Player Fall Death Text ID
Fields.Description: Text presentation ID shown when the player dies from a fall in 1v1.

Fields.Name: 1v1: Result Text ID
Fields.Description: Text presentation ID for the 1v1 win/loss result.

Fields.Name: 1v1: Time Up Text ID
Fields.Description: Text presentation ID shown when time runs out in 1v1.

Fields.Name: 1v1: Ally Entry Cutscene ID
Fields.Description: Cutscene ID for the entry of the ally side (team A) in 1v1.

Fields.Name: 1v1: Enemy Entry Cutscene ID
Fields.Description: Cutscene ID for the entry of the enemy side (team B) in 1v1.

Fields.Name: 1v1: Rounds to Win
Fields.Description: Number of rounds needed to win a 1v1 match.

Fields.Name: 1v1: Time Limit
Fields.Description: Time limit of a 1v1 (solo match) round.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Pre-Battle Text ID
Fields.Description: Text presentation ID shown before a 3v3 battle starts.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Battle Start Text ID
Fields.Description: Text presentation ID shown right after a 3v3 battle starts.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Opponent Destroyed Text ID
Fields.Description: Text presentation ID shown when an opponent is destroyed in 3v3.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Player Destroyed Text ID
Fields.Description: Text presentation ID shown when the player is destroyed in 3v3.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Player Fall Death Text ID
Fields.Description: Text presentation ID shown when the player dies from a fall in 3v3.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Respawn Text ID
Fields.Description: Text presentation ID shown when the player respawns in 3v3.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Time Up Text ID
Fields.Description: Text presentation ID shown when time runs out in 3v3.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Result Text ID
Fields.Description: Text presentation ID for the 3v3 win/loss result.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Ally Team Entry Cutscene ID
Fields.Description: Cutscene ID for the entry of the ally team (team A) in 3v3.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Enemy Team Entry Cutscene ID
Fields.Description: Cutscene ID for the entry of the enemy team (team B) in 3v3.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Base Points
Fields.Description: Base points used for 3v3 scoring.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Finishing Blow Bonus
Fields.Description: Bonus points for landing the finishing blow in 3v3.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Kill Leader Coefficient
Fields.Description: Coefficient used for the kill leader in 3v3 scoring.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Kill Leader Defeat Bonus
Fields.Description: Base bonus points for destroying the kill leader in 3v3.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Respawn Cooldown
Fields.Description: Cooldown before respawning in 3v3. In seconds.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Enemy No-Respawn Radius
Fields.Description: Radius of the circular area around each enemy where respawning is not allowed.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Ally Priority Respawn Radius
Fields.Description: Radius of the circular area around each ally where respawning is preferred.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Ally No-Respawn Radius
Fields.Description: Radius of the circular area around each ally where respawning is not allowed.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Resupply Unit Asset ID 1
Fields.Description: Asset ID of a resupply unit in 3v3 (1 of 8).

Fields.Name: 3v3: Resupply Unit Asset ID 2
Fields.Description: Asset ID of a resupply unit in 3v3 (2 of 8).

Fields.Name: 3v3: Resupply Unit Asset ID 3
Fields.Description: Asset ID of a resupply unit in 3v3 (3 of 8).

Fields.Name: 3v3: Resupply Unit Asset ID 4
Fields.Description: Asset ID of a resupply unit in 3v3 (4 of 8).

Fields.Name: 3v3: Resupply Unit Asset ID 5
Fields.Description: Asset ID of a resupply unit in 3v3 (5 of 8).

Fields.Name: 3v3: Resupply Unit Asset ID 6
Fields.Description: Asset ID of a resupply unit in 3v3 (6 of 8).

Fields.Name: 3v3: Resupply Unit Asset ID 7
Fields.Description: Asset ID of a resupply unit in 3v3 (7 of 8).

Fields.Name: 3v3: Resupply Unit Asset ID 8
Fields.Description: Asset ID of a resupply unit in 3v3 (8 of 8).

Fields.Name: 3v3: Resupply Unit Reuse Cooldown
Fields.Description: Cooldown before a resupply unit can be used again. In seconds.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Resupply Unit Recovery Rate
Fields.Description: Recovery speed of a resupply unit. In points per second.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Resupply Unit Action Button ID
Fields.Description: ActionButtonParam ID used to interact with a resupply unit.

Fields.Name: Battle Flow Sync Timeout
Fields.Description: Timeout for synchronising the battle flow, used at sync points such as the battle start and between rounds. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Result Screen Timeout
Fields.Description: Time before the result screen times out. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Matching Ticket Poll Interval
Fields.Description: Interval between matchmaking ticket poll requests. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Room Update Request Interval
Fields.Description: Interval between room update requests. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Remote Character Position Delay Gain
Fields.Description: Delay gain applied to the position of remote characters.

Fields.Name: Remote Position Delay Gain: Spectator
Fields.Description: Delay gain applied to the position of remote characters in spectator mode.

Fields.Name: Remote Character Warp Speed Threshold
Fields.Description: Speed above which a remote character warps to its position instead of moving there. In metres per second.

Fields.Name: BGM ID 0
Fields.Description: Background music ID (slot 0).

Fields.Name: BGM ID 1
Fields.Description: Background music ID (slot 1).

Fields.Name: BGM ID 2
Fields.Description: Background music ID (slot 2).

Fields.Name: BGM ID 3
Fields.Description: Background music ID (slot 3).

Fields.Name: BGM ID 4
Fields.Description: Background music ID (slot 4).

Fields.Name: BGM ID 5
Fields.Description: Background music ID (slot 5).

Fields.Name: BGM ID 6
Fields.Description: Background music ID (slot 6).

Fields.Name: BGM ID 7
Fields.Description: Background music ID (slot 7).

Fields.Name: BGM ID 8
Fields.Description: Background music ID (slot 8).

Fields.Name: BGM ID 9
Fields.Description: Background music ID (slot 9).

Fields.Name: 1v1: Defeat to Result Wait Time
Fields.Description: Wait time in 1v1 from a defeat or death until the win/lose display.

Fields.Name: 1v1: Result to Fade-Out Wait Time
Fields.Description: Wait time in 1v1 from the win/lose/draw display until the screen fades to black.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Time Up to Result Wait Time
Fields.Description: Wait time in 3v3 from time up until the win/lose/draw display.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Result to Fade-Out Wait Time
Fields.Description: Wait time in 3v3 from the win/lose/draw display until the screen fades to black.

Fields.Name: 3v3: Time Limit
Fields.Description: Time limit of a 3v3 (team match) battle.
